name: Tamba-Sasayama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tamba-Sasayama city emblem in green: a ring enclosing a stylised leaf-like stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Tamba-Sasayama, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 May 2000.

features.role: Tamba-Sasayama city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised leaf-like stroke
